Labrador_Retriever.name: Labrador Retriever
Labrador_Retriever.temperament: Friendly, Active, Outgoing, Gentle, Kind, Trusting
Labrador_Retriever.description: The Labrador Retriever is a medium-large breed of retriever-gun dog. They are known for their intelligence, good temperament, and love of water.
Labrador_Retriever.fun_fact: Labradors have been the most popular dog breed in the United States for 30 consecutive years!

German_Shepherd.name: German Shepherd
German_Shepherd.description: German Shepherds are working dogs developed originally for herding sheep. They are highly intelligent and trainable.
German_Shepherd.fun_fact: German Shepherds are the second most popular dog breed in the US and are commonly used as police and military dogs.

Golden_Retriever.name: Golden Retriever
Golden_Retriever.description: Golden Retrievers are friendly, intelligent and devoted dogs. They are always eager to please and excel in obedience training.
Golden_Retriever.fun_fact: Golden Retrievers have a 'soft mouth' which allows them to carry eggs without breaking them!

Bulldog.name: Bulldog
Bulldog.description: Bulldogs are known for their loose, wrinkled skin and distinctive pushed-in nose. They are calm, courageous, and friendly.
Bulldog.fun_fact: Bulldogs are known as the 'National Dog of England' and are mascots for many universities and sports teams.

Poodle.name: Poodle
Poodle.description: Poodles are highly intelligent and trainable dogs. They come in three sizes: Standard, Miniature, and Toy.
Poodle.fun_fact: Despite their fancy appearance, Poodles were originally bred as water retrievers!

Rottweiler.name: Rottweiler
Rottweiler.description: Rottweilers are powerful, loyal dogs known for their strength and protective nature. They are excellent guard dogs and family companions.
Rottweiler.fun_fact: Rottweilers were originally used by the Romans to drive cattle and guard outposts!
